purpose: Freeze one close-frontier-innovation factor, the complete 114-definition semantic library, all 112 eligible numeric comparisons, ordered no-return gates, and exactly one conditional 2019-2023 development trial before opening Campaign083 source rows or values.

candidate.name: intraday_close_frontier_innovation_share_238p
candidate.formula: For each independent 120-close half, count positions j=1..119 where c_j is strictly above the preceding running maximum or strictly below the preceding running minimum. Sum the two half-session counts and divide by exactly 238.
candidate.economic_hypothesis: Repeated strict expansion of the within-half close frontier identifies continuing information incorporation rather than price revisitation, and the completed discovery state may retain attention over the next three sessions.
candidate.source_grid: Require exactly the raw 09:30 row plus all 240 standard continuous-session bars; select exactly 09:31-11:30 and 13:01-15:00 and exclude 09:30 from the factor.
candidate.half_session_rule: Treat the two 120-close halves independently. The first close initializes running_min and running_max and contributes no opportunity; restart both at 13:01.
candidate.frontier_rule: At each later position compare the finite positive close with running_min and running_max computed only from earlier positions in that half. Count exactly one innovation when close<running_min or close>running_max, then update both frontiers.
candidate.tie_rule: Equality to either preceding frontier is not an innovation. Use exact float64 comparisons with no epsilon, rounding, tick conversion, jitter, or stochastic tie break.
candidate.constant_path_rule: A constant half or full stock-day is valid and contributes zero innovations rather than missing.
candidate.missing_semantics: Missing for invalid or duplicate source identity, source-grid mismatch, any selected nonfinite or nonpositive close, nonfinite score, or score outside [0,1]. Never impute, smooth, clip, bucket, rank, winsorize, neutralize, bridge lunch, or substitute another grid.
candidate.floating_point_rule: Use float64 closes and exact strict less-than/greater-than comparisons. Divide the integer count by exactly 238.0. Do not endpoint-canonicalize or clip an out-of-range score.

coverage_and_capacity_before_comparison_.coverage_basis: candidate finite rows divided by the identical frozen quality-and-listing eligible buyable rows over 2019-2025
coverage_and_capacity_before_comparison_.failed_gate_policy: Record the exact Campaign083 factor as terminal and stop before comparator values, daily price fields, or forward returns.

uniqueness_after_coverage_only.method: Within each identical quality-listing-candidate-and-comparison-eligible stock-day cross-section, compute pairwise-complete Spearman correlation between directional percentile scores, then take each comparator's median daily correlation.
uniqueness_after_coverage_only.numeric_comparator_order_definition: Use the exact v18 112-comparator order; Campaign082 is the final numeric comparator, while Campaign063 and Campaign079 remain semantic-only.
uniqueness_after_coverage_only.complete_definition_order_definition: Use the exact v18 complete 114-definition order, including structurally nonnumeric Campaign063 and pre-value terminal Campaign079 for semantic challenge only.
uniqueness_after_coverage_only.failed_gate_policy: Stop before daily prices or forward returns; do not change the close-frontier definition, strict tie rule, fields, direction, half reset, remove a comparator, neutralize, filter, subset, or rescue.

finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.label_partition_rule: Both t+1 entry and t+3 exit must lie inside the same train or validation partition as the signal; purge the final three signal sessions at every boundary.
finite_development_catalog_if_admitted.stress_2024_2025_rule: Open once for the whole frozen campaign only after a nonzero 2019-2023 development-survivor record; classify as historically exposed stress replay, never pristine holdout.
